question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"significant."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Significant"** means important, noteworthy, or having a strong impact. (महत्वपूर्ण, काफ़ी बड़ा (इतना कि दीख जाए)) • **Example**: *The new data revealed a **significant**__ increase in sales.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as the other options do not make sense in the context of the sentence. • Grammatically, **"significant" **is an adjective that can be used to modify a noun or pronoun. • The correct answer is option 4. • Correct passage: Humans have __assumed__ that animals do not have a life and maybe exploited in any way they see fit, but this __perspective__ is incorrect and must be altered before it is too late. We fail to recognise that the pain we __inflict__ on animals will come back to haunt us, and no matter how __**significant**__ the discovery we make by causing harm to animals, it will be futile. It can never ______ (5) ______ the human actions. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "bad,"** is an adjective that means unpleasant or undesirable. (बुरा, ख़राब, अप्रिय) • **Option 2, "limited,"** is an adjective that means restricted or confined. (संख्‍या, मात्रा आदि की दृष्टि से कम या नियंत्रित, सीमित) • **Option 3, "painful,"** is an adjective that means causing physical or emotional discomfort. (दर्द या पीड़ा उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला; पीड़ादायी) 41:Tff6, The correct answer is **"justify."**
